tools.name: inspect_eve_assembly_state
tools.description: Inspects live EVE Frontier Smart Assembly on-chain object metadata, owner capability ID, online power status, and attached Sui Move package digest. Use when verifying whether a Smart Turret, Smart Gate, or Smart Storage Unit is online and checking its bound Move module before interacting; for generating or auditing custom Sui Move assembly source code, use generate_eve_assembly_move instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'assembly_id' ('assembly_class' defaults to 'smart_gate'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

assembly_id.description: Hexadecimal Sui object ID or Frontier Smart Assembly identifier (e.g. '0x8f4a...c201' or 'assembly-alpha-01').

assembly_class.description: Smart Assembly hardware class used to validate expected capability fields; defaults to 'smart_gate' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Assembly On-Chain State & Capability Inspector

tools.name: audit_eve_tribe_standings
tools.description: Audits EVE Frontier Tribe diplomatic standings, friendly/hostile reputation scores, and pilot override entries across solar systems. Use when checking diplomatic relations or detecting conflicting friendly-fire rules across tribe registries; for compiling those standings into executable Sui Move Smart Gate ACL bytecode, use compile_eve_gate_acl instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'tribe_id' ('standing_filter' defaults to 'all'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

tribe_id.description: Primary Tribe identifier or registry object ID to audit (e.g. 'tribe-corinth-01').

standing_filter.description: Filter returned diplomatic relationships by tier; defaults to 'all' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Tribe Diplomatic Standings & Access Matrix Auditor

tools.name: generate_eve_assembly_move
tools.description: Generates and statically audits Sui Move smart contract modules for EVE Frontier Smart Assemblies using Witness, Capability, and HotPotato patterns. Use when authoring custom Sui Move extensions for Smart Gates, Smart Turrets, or Smart Storage Units; for simulating pre-signed Programmable Transaction Block command arrays before wallet execution, use simulate_eve_sui_ptb instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'contract_type' ('assembly_id' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (45 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

contract_type.description: Target EVE Frontier Smart Assembly archetype to synthesize and audit.

assembly_id.description: Optional Smart Assembly identifier to bind into module constants; defaults to 'frontier-assembly-01' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Sui Move Smart Assembly Contract Generator & Auditor

tools.name: compile_eve_gate_acl
tools.description: Compiles EVE Frontier Tribe access control lists, diplomatic standings, and surge-pricing toll rules into Sui Move Smart Gate AccessPolicy constraints. Use when configuring on-chain jump permissions and LUX/SUI toll schedules for a player-owned Smart Gate; for calculating optimal multi-system jump routes across existing stargates, use plan_eve_gate_route instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'gate_assembly_id' ('toll_mode' defaults to 'standing_tiered'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

toll_mode.description: Pricing curve applied to non-allied jumpers; defaults to 'standing_tiered' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Gate Tribe ACL & Dynamic Toll Bytecode Compiler

tools.name: simulate_eve_sui_ptb
tools.description: Simulates Sui Programmable Transaction Block (PTB) command sequences to detect unauthorized coin splits, object transfers, and unconsumed HotPotato receipts. Use when auditing an untrusted EVE Frontier transaction bundle before signing with a pilot wallet; for verifying pilot zkLogin JWT proofs and character ownership capabilities, use verify_eve_zklogin_character instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'ptb_commands_json' ('strictness_mode' defaults to 'strict_zero_drain'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (35 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

ptb_commands_json.description: JSON-serialized array of PTB commands or comma-separated Move calls (e.g. '[{"kind":"SplitCoins"},{"kind":"MoveCall"}]').

strictness_mode.description: Simulation policy controlling whether multi-transfer PTBs are blocked; defaults to 'strict_zero_drain' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Sui Move PTB Coin-Drain & HotPotato Safety Simulator

tools.name: verify_eve_zklogin_character
tools.description: Verifies EVE Frontier Sui zkLogin BN254 zero-knowledge proofs, ephemeral session signatures, and SmartCharacter ownership capabilities. Use when authenticating a pilot's off-chain OAuth/zkLogin session before granting tribe vault or dApp access; for auditing tribe-wide diplomatic standings and reputation registries, use audit_eve_tribe_standings instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'jwt_proof' ('ephemeral_scheme' defaults to 'ED25519'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

jwt_proof.description: Encoded Sui zkLogin proof payload or JWT session token string (minimum 20 characters).

ephemeral_scheme.description: Cryptographic signature scheme of the ephemeral session key; defaults to 'ED25519' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Sui zkLogin BN254 Proof & SmartCharacter Verifier

tools.name: plan_eve_gate_route
tools.description: Calculates optimal stargate jump routes between EVE Frontier solar systems minimizing gigajoule fuel consumption, LUX gate tolls, or jump count. Use when plotting a ship transit path across public and tribe-restricted Smart Gates; for identifying multi-system commodity arbitrage trade loops across Smart Storage Units, use find_eve_ssu_arbitrage instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'origin_system' ('destination_system' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

optimize_for.description: Routing objective function weighting fuel burn vs tolls; defaults to 'lowest_fuel' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Multi-Hop Smart Gate Fuel & Toll Route Planner

tools.name: optimize_eve_node_power
tools.description: Calculates Lagrange Network Node hourly gigajoule (GJ) fuel burn rates, capacity headroom, and offline vulnerability windows for connected Smart Assemblies. Use when balancing steady-state power allocations on a single Lagrange Network Node; for stress-testing node capacitor depletion under active hostile fleet bombardment, use simulate_eve_capacitor_siege instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'node_id' ('operating_profile' defaults to 'balanced'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

operating_profile.description: Power allocation profile across connected assemblies; defaults to 'balanced' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Lagrange Network Node Gigajoule & Fuel Burn Optimizer

tools.name: simulate_eve_capacitor_siege
tools.description: Simulates Lagrange Network Node gigajoule (GJ) capacitor drain under sustained hostile fleet siege and computes optimal assembly load-shedding order. Use when preparing base defense power-shedding schedules against an incoming hostile fleet; for calculating routine peacetime fuel burn and reserve headroom, use optimize_eve_node_power instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'node_id' ('siege_intensity' defaults to 'skirmish_frigate_squad'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

node_id.description: Target Lagrange Network Node identifier under siege simulation.

siege_intensity.description: Hostile fleet DPS and electronic-warfare drain tier; defaults to 'heavy_cruiser_wing' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Lagrange Node Siege Capacitor Depletion Simulator

tools.name: monitor_eve_constellation_fuel
tools.description: Monitors constellation-wide Lagrange Network Node fuel reserves, identifies the weakest sovereignty node, and calculates logistics convoy resupply urgency. Use when auditing multi-system sovereignty fuel health across an entire tribe constellation; for optimizing gigajoule load on a single individual Lagrange Network Node, use optimize_eve_node_power instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'constellation_id' ('alert_threshold_hours' defaults to '24h'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

constellation_id.description: Constellation or solar system cluster identifier (e.g. 'Frontier-Delta-09').

alert_threshold_hours.description: Minimum remaining fuel horizon before triggering convoy dispatch; defaults to '36h' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Constellation Sovereignty & Multi-Node Fuel Radar

tools.name: quote_eve_ssu_market
tools.description: Computes dynamic bonding-curve bid/ask quotes in LUX and per-transaction anti-drain caps for a player-owned Smart Storage Unit (SSU). Use when setting automated market-maker buy/sell prices for a single SSU vending inventory; for scanning multiple SSUs across star systems to find profitable trade routes, use find_eve_ssu_arbitrage instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'resource_type' ('pricing_regime' defaults to 'inventory_balanced'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

resource_type.description: EVE Frontier commodity or ore name to price (e.g. 'Crude Fuel Ore', 'Carbonaceous Alloy').

pricing_regime.description: Bonding-curve slope aggressiveness; defaults to 'inventory_balanced' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Storage Unit (SSU) Bonding-Curve Market Pricer

tools.name: find_eve_ssu_arbitrage
tools.description: Scans Smart Storage Unit (SSU) bid/ask spreads across star systems against ship cargo capacity and stargate fuel costs to rank net-profitable arbitrage loops. Use when planning multi-system trade runs to maximize net LUX profit per gigajoule of fuel burned; for calculating internal bid/ask market-maker quotes for your own SSU, use quote_eve_ssu_market instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'origin_system' ('hull_cargo_class' defaults to 'light_courier'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

origin_system.description: Starting solar system for the trade vessel (e.g. 'System-Alpha').

hull_cargo_class.description: Trade vessel hull class determining cargo volume and fuel mass; defaults to 'medium_hauler' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Multi-System SSU Commodity Arbitrage Route Finder

tools.name: analyze_eve_killmail_threats
tools.description: Analyzes on-chain EVE Frontier killmail.move events in a solar system to quantify gatecamp ambush probability and identify dominant hostile hull doctrines. Use when assessing solar system PvP danger before jumping a hauler or fleet into a system; for computing real-time weapon target-lock priorities during active grid combat, use prioritize_eve_turret_targets instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'system_id' ('time_window' defaults to '1h'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

system_id.description: Solar system identifier to analyze for recent killmail activity (e.g. 'System-Frontier-01').

time_window.description: Historical lookback window for killmail aggregation; defaults to '24h' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier On-Chain Killmail Threat & Gatecamp Ambush Analyzer

tools.name: prioritize_eve_turret_targets
tools.description: Evaluates radar contacts by range, transversal velocity, and Tribe standing to output deterministic Smart Turret target-lock priorities and fire authorizations. Use when ranking active grid radar contacts for automated Smart Turret engagement; for reviewing historical solar system killmails and ambush probabilities before transit, use analyze_eve_killmail_threats instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'turret_id' ('engagement_doctrine' defaults to 'highest_threat'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

engagement_doctrine.description: Target selection doctrine weighting range vs angular tracking; defaults to 'highest_threat' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Turret Angular Tracking & Target Priority Calculator
